name: Drive Password
description_en:
Drive Password is a password manager designed around a user’s Google Drive storage and Google Workspace collaboration. Its website describes encrypting each record before storing it in a DrivePasswordStorage folder, with a separate encrypted HTML file for each record.

The useful evaluation is whether that storage and sharing model fits the organization’s Google accounts, recovery policy and offboarding process. Owning the storage does not by itself prove independent recovery or eliminate dependence on the client software.
description_zh:
Drive Password 围绕用户的 Google Drive 存储及 Google Workspace 协作构建密码管理。官网描述先加密每条记录，再存入 DrivePasswordStorage 文件夹，每条记录对应一个加密 HTML 文件。

评估重点是这种存储和共享方式是否符合组织的 Google 账户、恢复政策与离职流程。拥有存储位置本身不能证明可独立恢复，也不等于无需客户端软件。

sections.title_zh: 理解基于 Drive 的记录模型
sections.en:
The product page says credentials are encrypted before being written to the user’s Drive and advertises web, mobile, desktop and Chrome clients. It also lists import, generated passwords and sharing of individual accounts or categories with teams. These are vendor descriptions, not an audit of encryption or network traffic.

For a hypothetical evaluation, create a disposable record, locate the resulting storage folder, verify retrieval on a second client and compare imported fields with the source. Do not treat a Drive folder as a verified backup until a restoration or export has been tested. Exact key handling, offline behavior and supported import formats were not established by the pages read.
sections.zh:
产品页称凭据在写入用户 Drive 前加密，并列出网页、移动、桌面及 Chrome 客户端；还提供导入、密码生成及按账户或分类向团队共享。这些是厂商说明，不是加密或网络流量审计。

假设评估可创建可丢弃记录，找到对应存储文件夹，核对另一客户端能否读取，并逐字段比较导入结果。未测试恢复或导出前，不应将 Drive 文件夹当作已验证备份。已读页面未明确密钥处理、离线行为及具体导入格式。

sections.title_zh: 核对保险库以外的权限
sections.en:
The homepage describes shared vaults and permissions, while its detailed feature text discusses teams and account/category sharing. Before adopting it for Workspace staff, test who may edit and reshare a test credential and what remains accessible after removing a member. Vault removal does not itself rotate an external application password or revoke an existing session.

The support page offers a contact form and asks for an explanation, often a screenshot and URL. Redact credentials and recovery material from any support attachment. This research did not sign in, import data, inspect source licenses or verify a specific MFA implementation.
sections.zh:
首页描述共享保险库和权限，详细功能文案则说明团队及账户／分类共享。用于 Workspace 员工前，应测试谁可编辑、再次分享测试凭据，以及移除成员后仍能访问什么。移出保险库本身不等于轮换外部应用密码或撤销现有会话。

支持页提供联系表单，要求说明问题，通常还需截图和 URL。支持附件应隐藏凭据和恢复材料。本文未登录、导入数据、查源码许可或验证具体 MFA 实现。

sections.title_en: Team capacity and the small free tier
sections.title_zh: 团队容量与小型免费版
sections.en:
The public page displays Small team at USD 25 per month for up to ten members, Regular at USD 55 for up to 25 and a quote above 25. Personal Pro displays USD 3 per month. Annual/monthly tabs and a two-free-month promotion are present, but the static reading does not establish the selected tab’s billed annual total. Confirm the checkout rather than multiplying a potentially discounted display.

Lite is an ongoing free plan with fifteen passwords, no sharing and no support. It can test a small personal workflow but does not represent the paid team-sharing experience. Google account/storage requirements, tax, renewal and contract terms remain separate checks.
sections.zh:
公开页显示 Small team 每月 25 美元、最多十人，Regular 每月 55 美元、最多 25 人，超过 25 人询价；个人 Pro 显示每月 3 美元。页面有年付／月付切换和赠两个月宣传，但静态读取不能确定所选标签的年付实收，须核对结账，不能直接将可能已优惠的月均价相乘。

Lite 是持续免费套餐，限十五条密码、无共享和支持，能测试小规模个人流程，不能代表付费团队共享体验。Google 账户／容量要求、税费、续费及合同条款仍需另查。
